title: Not great
text:
Not great. This is a nice idea for a comforter. It isn’t the best execution unfortunately. The material feels soft but it is incredibly thin and light weight. This isn’t really a problem as we live in a warm environment but I had expected it to be a little warmer.

The gray is a great neutral color and is very pretty. The Pom poms are a cute look. There are some loose threads but I like this for the look layered with some other blankets.

I don’t love the random feeling circles stitched into the comforter.

Overall, for the price, I’m not thrilled. This seems pricy for the quality and how thin it is.
